what_happened: Found the actual Sapience server source (brain_server.py, repo_link.py) and the vendor CLI dev-source (sapience_cli.py, with link_cmd) in a separate local checkout (~/Projects/Sapience/sapience-app), letting every status-code/response-shape claim in the dispatch be verified against ground truth instead of this extension's own flagged-stale deployed docs.

The dispatch's requirement (3) (a 404 from the link route must still write the binding file and report a degraded state) and requirement (4) (delegate pick-and-register to the vendor 'sapience link' CLI when installed) are not jointly satisfiable by pure delegation: the vendor CLI's own link_cmd writes nothing on a 404 ('Nothing was written.'). The plan must explicitly choose between (a) delegating only the pick/match step and keeping this script's own POST+write (and thus its 404 handling) in both the fallback and delegate paths, or (b) delegating fully and special-casing the vendor's 404 exit to perform the same write itself.

sapience-publish.sh's ko subcommand and sapience-vault-read.sh's notes_cid resolution both parse GET /v1/people/projects with a jq shape ('.projects' or bare array) that matches neither the real server response ({shared, received, ...}, confirmed by direct brain_server.py read) nor any other /v1/people/projects*-family response found in the server source -- likely a pre-existing silent-empty-result bug in both, out of this task's declared territory (neither file is in the Territory list) so not touched here, but recorded so the new pick-mode code in sapience-project-bind.sh does not copy the same incorrect pattern, and as a candidate follow-up task.
